description: Canonical mathematical object definitions, representation diversity profiles R(M), and quad-source alignments across Gallier (S_A), Axler (S_B), VMLS (S_C), and Boyd & Vandenberghe Convex Optimization (S_D)

canonical_objects.name: Vector Space / Vector Representation
canonical_objects.description: Collection of objects closed under vector addition and scalar multiplication over a field

canonical_objects.name: Subspace
canonical_objects.description: Subset of a vector space closed under addition and scalar multiplication

canonical_objects.name: Internal Direct Sum of Subspaces
canonical_objects.description: Decomposition of vector space into independent subspaces with trivial pairwise intersection

canonical_objects.name: Linear Combination
canonical_objects.description: Finite sum of vectors weighted by scalar coefficients

canonical_objects.name: Linear Span / Set of Linear Combinations
canonical_objects.description: Smallest subspace containing a given subset of vectors, consisting of all linear combinations

canonical_objects.name: Inner Product / Dot Product
canonical_objects.description: Positive-definite symmetric bilinear form inducing geometry and angle on vector spaces

canonical_objects.name: Euclidean Norm and Distance
canonical_objects.description: Square root of inner product of vector with itself, measuring length and metric separation

canonical_objects.name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality
canonical_objects.description: |<u, v>| <= ||u|| * ||v|| with equality iff u and v are linearly dependent

canonical_objects.name: Orthogonality and Angles
canonical_objects.description: Vanishing inner product (<u, v> = 0) and cosine angle between vectors

canonical_objects.name: Linear Independence
canonical_objects.description: Property that no vector in a set can be written as a linear combination of the remaining vectors

canonical_objects.name: Basis
canonical_objects.description: Linearly independent spanning set providing unique coordinate representations for all vectors

canonical_objects.name: Basis Extension Theorem
canonical_objects.description: Every linearly independent set can be extended to a basis in a finite-dimensional space

canonical_objects.name: Dimension
canonical_objects.description: Number of elements in any basis of a finite-dimensional vector space

canonical_objects.name: Subspace Dimension Sum Formula
canonical_objects.description: dim(U1 + U2) = dim U1 + dim U2 - dim(U1 ∩ U2)

canonical_objects.name: Linear Map / Matrix Transformation
canonical_objects.description: Structure-preserving function between vector spaces over the same field

canonical_objects.name: Kernel / Null Space
canonical_objects.description: Subspace of domain vectors mapped to zero by a linear map or matrix

canonical_objects.name: Range / Image / Column Space
canonical_objects.description: Subspace of codomain vectors attained by a linear map or span of matrix columns

canonical_objects.name: Rank-Nullity Theorem / Fundamental Theorem of Linear Maps
canonical_objects.description: dim V = dim null T + dim range T for any linear map T : V -> W on finite-dimensional V

canonical_objects.name: Matrix Representation & Multiplication
canonical_objects.description: Matrix whose columns are coordinates of basis images under a linear map and composition of maps

canonical_objects.name: Matrix Inverses & Invertibility
canonical_objects.description: Unique matrix A^{-1} such that A * A^{-1} = A^{-1} * A = I for non-singular square matrices

canonical_objects.name: Orthonormal Basis
canonical_objects.description: Basis of mutually orthogonal unit vectors in an inner product space

canonical_objects.name: Gram-Schmidt Orthogonalization Procedure
canonical_objects.description: Algorithm transforming a linearly independent set into an orthonormal set with identical spans

canonical_objects.name: Orthogonal Complement
canonical_objects.description: Subspace of all vectors orthogonal to every vector in a given subspace

canonical_objects.name: Orthogonal Projection
canonical_objects.description: Idempotent self-adjoint linear map projecting onto a subspace along its orthogonal complement, minimizing distance

canonical_objects.name: Moore-Penrose Pseudoinverse
canonical_objects.description: Generalization of inverse for non-invertible or rectangular linear maps / matrices satisfying (A^T A)^{-1} A^T

canonical_objects.name: Self-Adjoint / Symmetric Operator
canonical_objects.description: Linear operator equal to its adjoint, having real eigenvalues and orthogonal eigenspaces

canonical_objects.name: Spectral Theorem for Self-Adjoint Operators
canonical_objects.description: Orthogonal decomposition of a vector space into eigenspaces of a self-adjoint operator

canonical_objects.name: QR Factorization
canonical_objects.description: Decomposition of matrix A into orthogonal matrix Q and upper-triangular matrix R via Gram-Schmidt

canonical_objects.name: Gram Matrix
canonical_objects.description: Matrix of pairwise inner products G = A^T A, symmetric positive semi-definite

canonical_objects.name: Affine Set and Affine Combinations
canonical_objects.description: Set containing the line through any two distinct points in the set

canonical_objects.name: Convex Set and Convex Combinations
canonical_objects.description: Set containing the line segment between any two points in the set: lambda x + (1-lambda) y in C

canonical_objects.name: Convex Cone and Conic Combinations
canonical_objects.description: Set closed under nonnegative linear combinations: theta1 x1 + theta2 x2 in K for theta1, theta2 >= 0

canonical_objects.name: Hyperplanes and Halfspaces
canonical_objects.description: Hyperplane {x | a^T x = b} and halfspaces {x | a^T x <= b}, forming affine and convex sets

canonical_objects.name: Euclidean Balls and Ellipsoids
canonical_objects.description: Ball B(xc, r) = {x | ||x - xc|| <= r} and ellipsoid E = {x | (x - xc)^T P^{-1} (x - xc) <= 1}

canonical_objects.name: Norm Balls and Norm Cones
canonical_objects.description: Cone {(x, t) | ||x|| <= t} in R^{n+1}, called second-order cone or Lorentz cone for l2-norm

canonical_objects.name: Polyhedra and Simplices
canonical_objects.description: Intersection of finite number of halfspaces and hyperplanes: {x | A x <= b, C x = d}

canonical_objects.name: Positive Semidefinite Cone
canonical_objects.description: Convex cone S_+^n of symmetric positive semidefinite n x n matrices

canonical_objects.name: Convexity Preserving Set Operations
canonical_objects.description: Operations that preserve convexity: intersection, affine functions, perspective, and linear-fractional functions

canonical_objects.name: Proper Cones and Generalized Inequalities
canonical_objects.description: Partial ordering x <=_K y defined by a convex, closed, solid, pointed cone K

canonical_objects.name: Separating Hyperplane Theorem
canonical_objects.description: Two disjoint convex sets can be separated by a hyperplane: a^T x <= b for all x in C and a^T x >= b for all x in D

canonical_objects.name: Supporting Hyperplane Theorem
canonical_objects.description: For any boundary point x0 of a convex set C, there exists a supporting hyperplane containing x0

canonical_objects.name: Dual Cones and Dual Generalized Inequalities
canonical_objects.description: Dual cone K* = {y | x^T y >= 0 for all x in K}, self-dual for nonnegative orthant and PSD cone

canonical_objects.name: Convex Function and First-Order Condition
canonical_objects.description: Function f where f(lambda x + (1-lambda) y) <= lambda f(x) + (1-lambda) f(y), with f(y) >= f(x) + grad f(x)^T (y-x)

canonical_objects.name: Second-Order Convexity Condition
canonical_objects.description: Twice differentiable function f is convex iff its Hessian is positive semidefinite: grad^2 f(x) >= 0

canonical_objects.name: Epigraph and Sublevel Sets
canonical_objects.description: Epigraph epi f = {(x, t) | f(x) <= t} is a convex set iff f is a convex function

canonical_objects.name: Jensen's Inequality
canonical_objects.description: f(E[x]) <= E[f(x)] for convex function f and random variable x

canonical_objects.name: Fenchel Conjugate Function
canonical_objects.description: Convex conjugate f*(y) = sup_{x} (y^T x - f(x)), always convex even if f is not

canonical_objects.name: Quasiconvex Functions
canonical_objects.description: Function with convex sublevel sets S_alpha = {x | f(x) <= alpha} for all alpha

canonical_objects.name: Standard Convex Optimization Problem
canonical_objects.description: Minimization of convex objective f0(x) subject to convex inequality constraints fi(x) <= 0 and affine equality constraints Ax = b

canonical_objects.name: Linear Programming (LP)
canonical_objects.description: Convex optimization with affine objective c^T x and polyhedral constraints G x <= h, A x = b

canonical_objects.name: Quadratic Programming (QP)
canonical_objects.description: Minimization of convex quadratic objective (1/2) x^T P x + q^T x subject to affine constraints

canonical_objects.name: Quadratically Constrained Quadratic Programming (QCQP)
canonical_objects.description: Convex optimization with quadratic objective and convex quadratic inequality constraints

canonical_objects.name: Second-Order Cone Programming (SOCP)
canonical_objects.description: Linear objective minimized subject to second-order cone constraints ||Ai x + bi|| <= ci^T x + di

canonical_objects.name: Semidefinite Programming (SDP)
canonical_objects.description: Linear objective minimized subject to linear matrix inequality (LMI) constraints x1 F1 + ... + xn Fn <= G

canonical_objects.name: Lagrangian and Lagrange Dual Function
canonical_objects.description: L(x, lambda, nu) = f0(x) + sum lambda_i fi(x) + sum nu_i hi(x) and g(lambda, nu) = inf_x L(x, lambda, nu)

canonical_objects.name: Weak and Strong Duality
canonical_objects.description: Weak duality d* <= p* always holds; strong duality d* = p* holds under constraint qualifications

canonical_objects.name: Slater's Constraint Qualification
canonical_objects.description: Existence of strictly feasible point x in relint D satisfying fi(x) < 0 guarantees strong duality

canonical_objects.name: Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) Conditions
canonical_objects.description: Primal feasibility, dual feasibility, complementary slackness lambda_i fi(x*) = 0, and gradient of Lagrangian vanishing

canonical_objects.name: Linear Least Squares Problem
canonical_objects.description: Minimization of residual Euclidean norm squared ||A x - b||^2 over x

canonical_objects.name: Normal Equations
canonical_objects.description: Necessary and sufficient optimality condition A^T A x = A^T b for linear least squares

canonical_objects.name: Tikhonov Regularization
canonical_objects.description: Multi-objective least squares objective minimizing ||A x - b||^2 + lambda * ||x||^2

canonical_objects.name: Projection onto a Convex Set
canonical_objects.description: Unique minimizer PC(x) = argmin_{z in C} ||x - z|| characterized by (x - PC(x))^T (z - PC(x)) <= 0 for all z in C

canonical_objects.name: Distance Between Convex Sets
canonical_objects.description: Minimization problem dist(C, D) = inf {||x - y|| | x in C, y in D}, convex when C and D are convex

canonical_objects.name: Analytic Center and Barrier Methods
canonical_objects.description: Minimizer of logarithmic barrier function -sum log(-fi(x)) for a set of convex inequalities
